description: Frame described vaguely as 'a coordinate system' without specifying its essential components (origin + axes)

Explanation is circular: states sensor is welded to link frame to explain why link-frame coordinates don't change, but doesn't explain why world coordinates do change (link frame rotates with link, world frame does not)
the tip's coordinates just come from 'summing x and y' — the components are not attributed to the links that contribute them
polite form is freely usable in narration with punctuation tricks — register is optional
both frames equally invent a force and ground-frame gravity is just the more believable invention
robot frame problem is only that the goal moves, not that each sensor measurement is expressed in its own frame
pillars are performing/analyzing/verifying/verifying-with-emotion rather than the vault's four named pillars
